newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti no comment on closer Fr Tel link.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti no comment on closer Fr Tel link.

text.p: Italy's Olivetti had no comment to make on a report in the International Herald Tribune on Monday about a strategic alliance with France Telecom, and the French group taking an equity stake in Olivetti.

An Olivetti spokeswoman said that the group was having talk with a number of companies around the world and that France Telecom was one of them after a preliminary agreement last November to set up a fixed-line Italian telephone network.

In November, Olivetti announced a joint venture with France Telecom to set up Italy's second major telephone network, in a venture that would bring in U.S. telecom groups Bell Atlantic and Sprint together with German Deutsche Telekom.
Negotiations over this agreement are still going on and are expected to be finalised in 1996, said the Olivetti spokeswoman.
Olivetti's newly-appointed chief executive Roberto Colannino said last week after his appointment that he would take one month to review the strategy of the group.
